subject: Portfolio stability check — renewal forecast checkpoint
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Portfolio stability check — renewal forecast checkpoint

Sarah / team —

Quick note to surface where ACME sits in our renewal forecast and to ask for a short stage/status refresh from your side. We ran a portfolio stability sweep this morning and flagged ACME as a medium-risk renewal: ARR trending flat, two seats inactive across April, and an open billing question on last month’s invoice. High-level snapshot attached (acme_commit_snapshot_20280430.csv) and a one-slide forecast summary (forecast_slide_v2.pdf).

What I’m asking for:
- Can you confirm current contract stage (Committed / At-Risk / Renewal in Negotiation) and any internal blockers?
- If At-Risk, please call out the top two drivers (usage, pricing, exec alignment, support).
- If helpful, suggest a 30-min call window this week for a short remediation plan.

Proposed next steps from our side (if you confirm At-Risk):
- Run feature-usage audit and share a short usage export (we’ve included a template).
- Offer a one-time credits path if the issue is billing-related and within policy.
- Schedule a joint exec touch if adoption is the core concern.

Can you reply by EOD Wednesday PDT with your stage and any notes? If you’d prefer a quick call today, I’m available after 3pm PT.

Thanks —
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: acme_commit_snapshot_20280430.csv (CSV summary of ARR/stage/last-touch), forecast_slide_v2.pdf (1-slide forecast view)

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecloud.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@acmecloud.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portfolio stability check — renewal forecast checkpoint

Thanks, Nikhil — appreciate the heads up.

Quick answers:
- Stage: Team currently shows us in "Renewal in Negotiation" on our side, but procurement opened a question about last month’s overage charges. That’s the blocker for committing to the renewed ARR figure.
- Top drivers: (1) billing discrepancy, (2) two seats not in use (we’re auditing whether they should be reallocated).

I can provide the usage export by EOD tomorrow. In the meantime, what’s your standard timeframe for a one-time billing credit approval? I can loop procurement if there’s a path that gets us back to commit.

If you want to chat, I can do 4:30–5:00pm PT today.

Best,
Sarah Lin
Head of Platform Operations, Acme Cloud
sarah.lin@acmecloud.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: 
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 13:36:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Portfolio stability check — renewal forecast checkpoint (internal triage)

Nikhil / David —

Putting together an internal triage plan for ACME before we escalate externally. I split remediation into three buckets (Green / Orange / Red) with explicit actions and owners. See checklist attached (triage-checklist.pdf) and a quick usage export sample (acme_active-feature-usage.csv) you can send to Sarah.

Triage summary (short):
- Red (needs exec / credit): Billing dispute > $25k or procurement hold. Action: Open finance escalation, designate runbook owner (David), prepare DocuSign snapshot for revised terms. Target: 48 hours.
- Orange (adoption / seats): Low usage on Search + Embeddings — outreach + deployment assist. Action: Solutions check, schedule 45-min enablement session. Owner: Nikhil. Target: 5 business days.
- Green (administrative / timing): Minor timing mismatch or internal approvals. Action: Monitor and nudge. Owner: AM. Target: 10 business days.

Immediate asks for this thread:
1) Nikhil — send Sarah the usage-export template and offer the 4:30pm slot if still available.
2) David — if billing looks like a $25k+ exposure, open a finance case (FIN-ACME-0428) and ping me.
3) Nikhil — add proposed exec touch options to the HubSpot deal (link below).

I’ve attached the checklist and a small script we use to generate the usage CSV. If we need to offer a credit, we’ll follow the standard cadence (Finance + CS + Sales approval).

Marissa Cole
Head of Renewals Enablement, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: triage-checklist.pdf (internal triage matrix), acme_active-feature-usage.csv (usage export template)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Apr 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portfolio stability check — renewal forecast checkpoint

Sarah — thanks for the quick reply and for flagging procurement. Confirming the 4:30–5:00pm PT slot works for me; I’ve put a Calendly link below to lock 20 minutes. If that’s tight, we can extend to 30.

Per Marissa’s note, I’ve attached the usage-export template (acme_active-feature-usage.csv) — if you can drop the export there by EOD tomorrow we’ll:
- Have David triage billing exposure if it’s >$25k.
- Run an adoption check and propose a 45-minute enablement session next week (solutions + CS).

Tentative next steps after our call:
- If billing is the blocker, Finance will route a credit review; we’ll aim for decision within 48 hours.
- If adoption, schedule enablement and track feature activation over a two-week window.

I’ve also linked the HubSpot deal and the forecast slide in case procurement wants the one-pager.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/nikhil-sharma/acme-renewal-check
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2028-RNW
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-acme-forecast-v2

Thanks all — talk soon.

—
